biography: Jateen Narsai is an IT professional with over 15 years’ experience in business and systems analysis, process improvement and software solution design. His work includes customer onboarding, approval workflows and reporting automation. He works across requirements, solution documentation, testing and implementation support, with a focus on reducing manual effort and making systems easier to use.
